import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'; import { siteConfig } from '@/shared/config/site'; import { createScopedLogger } from '@/shared/utils/logger'; const logger = createScopedLogger('RSSFeedAPI'); const baseUrl = siteConfig.url; // Mock data - in production, this would come from your CMS/database const blogPosts = [ { title: 'Vietnam Coffee Export Guide 2024: Complete B2B Sourcing Manual', description: 'Comprehensive guide to Vietnamese coffee export including Robusta and Arabica sourcing, pricing, logistics, and quality standards for international buyers.', slug: 'vietnam-coffee-export-guide-2024', publishedAt: '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z', updatedAt: '2024-01-15T10:00:00Z', author: 'The Great Beans Team', category: 'Export Guide', tags: ['vietnam coffee', 'export guide', 'robusta', 'arabica', 'sourcing'], }, { title: 'Robusta vs Arabica: Complete Comparison for Coffee Importers', description: 'Detailed comparison of Vietnamese Robusta and Arabica coffee beans including flavor profiles, pricing, processing methods, and market applications.', slug: 'robusta-vs-arabica-complete-comparison', publishedAt: '2024-01-10T09:00:00Z', updatedAt: '2024-01-10T09:00:00Z', author: 'The Great Beans Team', category: 'Coffee Education', tags: ['robusta', 'arabica', 'comparison', 'coffee types', 'import guide'], }, { title: 'Vietnamese Coffee Processing Methods: Washed vs Natural vs Honey', description: 'Understanding different coffee processing methods used in Vietnam and their impact on flavor, quality, and pricing for international markets.', slug: 'vietnamese-coffee-processing-methods', publishedAt: '2024-01-05T08:00:00Z', updatedAt: '2024-01-05T08:00:00Z', author: 'The Great Beans Team', category: 'Processing', tags: [ 'coffee processing', 'washed coffee', 'natural coffee', 'honey process', 'vietnam', ], }, { title: 'Coffee Export Logistics from Vietnam: Shipping, Incoterms & Documentation', description: 'Complete guide to coffee export logistics from Vietnam including shipping options, Incoterms, documentation requirements, and cost optimization.', slug: 'coffee-export-logistics-vietnam', publishedAt: '2024-01-01T07:00:00Z', updatedAt: '2024-01-01T07:00:00Z', author: 'The Great Beans Team', category: 'Logistics', tags: [ 'export logistics', 'shipping', 'incoterms', 'documentation', 'vietnam export', ], }, ]; const marketReports = [ { title: 'Vietnam Coffee Market Report Q1 2024: Production & Export Trends', description: 'Quarterly analysis of Vietnam coffee market including production forecasts, export volumes, pricing trends, and global market outlook.', slug: 'vietnam-coffee-market-q1-2024', publishedAt: '2024-01-20T12:00:00Z', updatedAt: '2024-01-20T12:00:00Z', author: 'Market Analysis Team', category: 'Market Report', tags: [ 'market report', 'vietnam coffee', 'production', 'export trends', 'pricing', ], }, ]; function generateRSSFeed() { const allContent = [ ...blogPosts.map(post => ({ ...post, type: 'blog' })), ...marketReports.map(report => ({ ...report, type: 'market-report' })), ].sort( (a, b) => new Date(b.publishedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.publishedAt).getTime() ); const rssItems = allContent .map( item => ` <![CDATA[${item.title}]]> ${baseUrl}/en/${item.type === 'blog' ? 'blog' : 'market-reports'}/${item.slug} ${baseUrl}/en/${item.type === 'blog' ? 'blog' : 'market-reports'}/${item.slug} ${new Date(item.publishedAt).toUTCString()} info@thegreatbeans.com (${item.author}) ${item.tags.map(tag => ``).join('')} ${item.description}

Tags: ${item.tags.join(', ')}

About The Great Beans: Leading Vietnamese coffee exporter specializing in premium Robusta and Arabica beans with direct farm sourcing, competitive pricing, and comprehensive logistics solutions for global markets.

Contact: For wholesale inquiries and custom sourcing solutions, contact us at info@thegreatbeans.com

]]> ` ) .join(''); return ` <![CDATA[The Great Beans - Vietnamese Coffee Export Insights]]> ${baseUrl} en-US ${new Date().toUTCString()} ${new Date().toUTCString()} 60 ${baseUrl}/images/logo.png The Great Beans ${baseUrl} 144 144 The Great Beans - Premium Vietnamese Coffee Export info@thegreatbeans.com (The Great Beans Team) tech@thegreatbeans.com (The Great Beans Tech Team) Copyright ${new Date().getFullYear()} The Great Beans. All rights reserved. https://www.rssboard.org/rss-specification The Great Beans RSS Generator ${rssItems} `; } export async function GET(_request: NextRequest) { try { const rssContent = generateRSSFeed(); return new NextResponse(rssContent, { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/rss+xml; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=3600, s-maxage=3600', 'X-Robots-Tag': 'index, follow', }, }); } catch (error) { // API error logging removed for production return new NextResponse('Error generating RSS feed', { status: 500 }); } }

    content: `# Vietnamese Coffee Culture: Where Tradition Meets Innovation

Vietnam's coffee culture is a fascinating blend of French colonial influence, local traditions, and modern innovation. As the world's second-largest coffee producer, Vietnam has developed a unique coffee identity that extends far beyond the famous ca phe sua da (iced coffee with condensed milk).

## The Historical Foundation

Coffee was introduced to Vietnam by French colonists in the 1850s, but it wasn't until the 1980s that Vietnam truly emerged as a coffee powerhouse. The Doi Moi economic reforms opened the door for coffee cultivation to expand rapidly, particularly in the Central Highlands region.

### Traditional Brewing Methods

Vietnamese coffee culture is characterized by several distinctive brewing methods:

**Phin Filter**: The iconic Vietnamese drip filter, known as "phin," produces a strong, concentrated coffee that drips slowly into a cup. This method allows for a meditative coffee experience, encouraging patience and mindfulness.

**Ca Phe Sua Da**: Perhaps Vietnam's most famous coffee preparation, this iced coffee with sweetened condensed milk perfectly balances the strong, bitter coffee with creamy sweetness.

**Ca Phe Trung**: Egg coffee, a Hanoi specialty, combines coffee with whipped egg yolk, sugar, and condensed milk, creating a rich, custard-like beverage.

## Modern Innovations

Today's Vietnamese coffee industry is embracing innovation while respecting tradition:

### Specialty Coffee Movement

A new generation of Vietnamese coffee entrepreneurs is focusing on:
- Single-origin Arabica cultivation in high-altitude regions
- Improved processing methods for better flavor profiles
- Direct trade relationships with international buyers
- Sustainable farming practices

### Technology Integration

Modern Vietnamese coffee operations are incorporating:
- Precision agriculture techniques
- Advanced processing equipment
- Quality control laboratories
- Traceability systems

## The Global Impact

Vietnamese coffee innovations are influencing global coffee trends:

**Robusta Renaissance**: Vietnam's high-quality Robusta is changing perceptions about this coffee variety, proving that Robusta can be specialty-grade.

**Processing Innovations**: Vietnamese producers are experimenting with honey processing, natural fermentation, and other methods traditionally associated with Arabica.

**Sustainable Practices**: Many Vietnamese farms are leading the way in sustainable coffee production, implementing water conservation, organic farming, and fair labor practices.

## Cultural Significance

Coffee in Vietnam is more than a beverage; it's a social institution:

- **Community Gathering**: Coffee shops serve as community centers where people gather to socialize, conduct business, and relax.
- **Generational Bridge**: Coffee culture connects older and younger generations, with traditional methods being passed down while embracing new trends.
- **Economic Driver**: Coffee provides livelihoods for millions of Vietnamese families and contributes significantly to the national economy.

## Looking Forward

The future of Vietnamese coffee culture lies in balancing tradition with innovation:

- Preserving traditional brewing methods while exploring new techniques
- Maintaining cultural authenticity while appealing to global markets
- Supporting small farmers while scaling production sustainably
- Honoring the past while embracing technological advancement

Vietnamese coffee culture continues to evolve, offering the world a unique perspective on coffee that combines respect for tradition with a spirit of innovation. As global coffee consumers become more sophisticated, Vietnamese coffee's distinctive character and quality are gaining recognition worldwide.
